description: Use when you need to write, test, or tune YARA rules for malware detection and hunting. Covers rule anatomy, string types and modifiers, condition logic, the pe/elf/math/hash/dotnet modules, testing against clean and malicious corpora, measuring false positives, atom quality for performance, and YARA-X differences. Use when static triage finds a new family, when you need hunt rules for an incident, or when an existing rule fires too much or too little.
